messages.content:
<state>tense, a bit guarded</state>
<word>Hi. I, um, got my midterm back last week and I haven't really been okay since.</word>
Thank you for sharing that. It sounds like that grade has stayed with you. What has been going through your mind since you saw it?

<state>worry about failing rises</state>
<word>Mostly that I'm going to fail the whole course. I lie in bed at 2am replaying the exam, and then I'm too wiped out to go to my morning lecture.</word>
That sounds exhausting. When you miss the lecture, what do you tell yourself about it?
